content: In brief, we use contextualised representations of ambiguous words from the top layer of an ELMo model to train word sense classifiers and find out whether using lemmas instead of tokens helps in this task (see Section SECREF5). We experiment with the English and Russian languages and show that they differ significantly in the influence of lemmatization on the WSD performance of ELMo models.
